claims.text: The Palais-Royal was originally called the Palais-Cardinal, as it was famously built for Cardinal Richelieu between 1633 and 1639.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: It earned its royal title when Anne of Austria moved in to get away from the nearby Louvre palace.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Over the years, the powerful Dukes of Orléans made such extensive alterations that almost nothing of the original design survives today.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The palace completely encloses a beautiful, peaceful central garden that is lined by covered shopping arcades.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: In 1789, it became the scene of a seminal event of the French Revolution when Camille Desmoulins made a famous declaration to the crowds here.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Today, this former royal residence serves as the prestigious seat of the Ministry of Culture, the Conseil d'État, and the Constitutional Council.
claims.subject: self
